notes.title: Update v0.5.3: Daily Reward & New PvE Challenges
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

This update focuses on improving the new player experience and introducing new PvE content.


 Added new tutorials in the menu when accessing the Play, Collection and Deck Edit sections for the first time
 Added a daily reward on log in. Each day you log in you will get a predefined reward. 
 Renamed Events into Challenges. Added three new challenges, two of which will change each week.
 Rookie Challenge - This is a one off challenge intended to allow new players a slower ramp time before they jump into ranked.
 Weekly Challenge - This one is similar to the playoff event. Each week a new set of teams will be in the challenge.
 Boss Challenge - These are extremely difficult challenges that offer a single opponent and will change each week.
 Reworked the back-end purchase flow to make it more resilient and better treat some purchase edge cases.


Thank you and good luck!

notes.title: Update v0.5.2b: Passive and Player Tuning
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We did a few sever side passive and player changes:

Passive Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 2 Defensive Debuff changed to Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 1 Defensive Debuff.
Passive Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 2 Offensive Debuff changed to Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 1 Offensive Debuff.

Affected players: Devon Bookr, Bogdan Bogdanovic, Cedin Hosman, Jaben Harby, Arjay Bartett, Cris Lavert, Camm Redish & Vlathko Kancar.

These two passives were creating a small counter synergy on exploit players since they initially applied a Tier 2 debuff. Lower tier debuffs cannot be applied over higher tier ones, and most skills apply tier 1 debuffs. Due to this, there were less triggers overall for exploit themed players.

Devon Bookr
Added passive Match End: Shoot all BONUS SHOTS.

Devon was a bit underwhelming after the last patch due to the anti synergy described above and the loss of Bonus Shots at the end of the match. We're reintroducing this ability just for him since he is designed to be a self contained BS generator and a lot of his power comes from this.

Camm Redish
Salary reduced from 14 to 13.

Cris Lavert
Salary reduced from 16 to 15.

Jaben Harby
Salary reduced from 10 to 9.

Thank you and good luck!

notes.title: Update v0.5.2: Roster Update, New Ladder Season, Balance Pass & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

In this update, we do a final pass on the season 2 player roster, a major balance pass, and fix a bunch of issues that have affected the game for a while.

General Changes & Fixes

 Fixed and issue that would cause the game to freeze when certain auras interacted;
 Fixed visual issue with particles when opening packs;
 Fixed pack shadow being visible briefly when opening a pack;
 Fixed quest reward text being displayed on two lines instead of one;
 Increased rotating shop slot count from 1 to 3;
 Updated starter collection based on the new player roster;
 Significantly reduced completion threshold for most quests;
 Updated team colors for players based on latest transfers;
 Added Fame rewards for ladder ranks;
 Modified the opponent team from the final match in the tutorial to decrease difficulty.


Gameplay Changes

 Bonus Shots and Bonus Passes are no longer thrown at the end of the match;
 Players shoot from offensive rebounding even if they are exhausted;
 3 Point Chance has been changed to now be a main attribute of the players. Each player will have a 3P Chance attribute that reflects their real life 3PFGA/FGA percentage. notes.title: Season 2 Preview - Gameplay Changes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

With Season 2 fast approaching, we'd like to take the time to go over some of the changes we will be doing to the core mechanics, and the reasoning behind them. 

Card Type Abilities
One of the areas of concern we have with the current gameplay experience is related to the card type abilities:

 Strength - Offensive Rebound: Get +20 TURN METER
 Skill - Activate 2: Shoot 1
 Speed - Activate 2: Pass 1
 Will - Steal: Get +30 TURN METER

Balance wise, the STR and SPD abilities are significantly more powerful than their SKL & WILL counterparts. 

SPD players on average get more activations than SKL players (around 20-25% more) due to their higher native playmaking. Even though the abilities look similar, SPD players trigger theirs more often. The fact that the second trigger requires 4 activations also works against SKL as there are very few players of that archetype that can reliably get to 4 activations in a single match.

STR is the most problematic because it enables chain activations on the same team. How this works is:

 One of your player activates and shoots
 You get offensive rebounds on your STR players and they get turn meter
 The turn meter they get pushes them over the activations threshold
 STR player activates and shoots
 More offensive rebounds that push other STR players over the activation threshold
 This can repeat several times, allowing 3-5 consecutive activations 

Let's call this the Valaciunas paradox. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/13cac2e999fba98eb151c394dbfa7bdd85fa1754.jpg
The more you shoot, the more offensive rebounds you get. The more offensive rebounds, the more activations you get. The more activations you get, the more you shoot, and so on. Overall, it's not a great experience for anyone playing against it.

When we compare it to the WILL ability, the turn meter boost from stealing occurs on the opponent's turn. This will break the consecutive activation chain, and allow for a more even distribution of the activations. You get the chance to react to what the opponent is doing, which is great for the gameplay experience.

All of this being said, we are happy with the SPD & WILL abilities, but are changing the SKL and STR ones to the following:

 Strength - Defensive Rebound 2: Get +15 TURN METER
 Skill - Shoot: Give opponent +10% FOUL CHANCE this turn


The STR ability is moving to defensive rebounding. It will now act in the same way as the WILL one, in that it will break chain activations for your opponent because it now generates the turn meter on their turn.

For SKL we wanted to try something different. We've been wanting to incorporate fouling into the core experience for a while, and taking this opportunity to do so. Gameplay wise, this makes SKL players more reliable scorers (from extra free throws) compared to the previous version.

Mismatch/Dominated

Another area we though needed improvement was the Mismatch/Dominated matrix and abilities.
Currently we have SKL > SPD > STR > WILL > SKL, and the current bonuses are:

 Strength - +20 OFFENSE & +20 REBOUNDING
 Skill - +30 OFFENSE
 Speed - +20 OFFENSE & +10 PLAYMAKING
 Will - +20 OFFENSE & +10 DEFENSE


One first issues is that the bonuses mismatch gives are too powerful. They are equivalent to three tier 1 buffs. We are toning them down to be equivalent to two tier 1 buffs.

Secondly, the current structure does not make much sense when we consider how the archetypes have evolved. We decided to change the mismatch matrix and abilities as follows:

SPD > SKL
SPD players get +10 OFFENSE & +10 PLAYMAKING when facing a SKL players.
SPD player are supposed to be active playmakers. They are the best passers in the game, while SKL has the least steal. They will out activate, out maneuver and out volume their SKL opponents. 

SKL > STR
STR players get -10 DEFENSE & -5% BLOCK when facing a SKL players.
SKL players are shooters, with a focus on 3P shots. 3P shots are rarely blocked, and big men don't generally defend well against them.

STR > WILL
WILL players get -10 DEFENSE & -15 REBOUNDING when facing a STR players.
WILL players are good defenders, but it's difficult to defend against big men in the paint. Similarly, while WILL players are the 2nd best rebounders in the game, STR players will assert their dominance in rebounding when going for the same ball.

WILL > SPD
WILL players get +10 OFFENSE & +7% STEAL when facing a SPD players.
WILL players will shut down the pass focused SPD players more easily. Their native high defense is already good enough to prevent SPD players from scoring, but they need a bit of help on the offensive side to keep up on the scoring side.

All these changes will be available on the steam beta branch starting next week. Details on how to access it will be posted separately.

Thank you for reading, and good luck!

notes.title: Update v0.4.1: Balance Update, New Ladder Season & 41 New Cards
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Aside from the new player additions, the focus for this patch was a partial update of players for the new season, and giving the debuff archetype a much needed boost. Debuff had lagged behind compared to other archetypes, mostly from a lack of support players to go with it. 

General Changes & Fixes

 Auras and traits are now disabled when a player is exhausted. This has long been an issue and allowed things like aura stacking to circumvent Exhausted. Actions based passives are not disabled (eg. Get Bonus Pass on offensive rebounding/steal/miss, etc).
 Fixed and issue where MMR was not updating at the correct interval.
 Most Exploit (debuff) themed players received an extra passive. Either Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 2 Defensive Debuff or Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 2 Offensive Debuff.


New Ladder Season
The ladder ranks have been reset. All players are pushed back one division compared to their rank at the end of the season:

 All Star -> Diamond 5
 Diamond -> Gold 5
 Gold -> Silver 5
 Silver -> Bronze 5
 Bronze -> Bronze 5


When playing in the new seasons you will earn all rewards from the lower divisions after playing one match.

Skill Changes
Clog the Paint now gives 3P CHANCE DOWN I to all players instead of just SKL, SPD & STR players.

Not applying to everyone simply did not make sense. Now it can reliably be incorporated into the self debuff/anti debuff archetype.

notes.content:
Ranked Mode

Ranked mode is finally here! Here is how it works.

There are 5 divisions: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond and All-Star. The first four divisions consist of 5 sub divisions each.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/ffe1a930f269abf3a8d111e5b1376a34395d2690.png

Winning a match grants you a star for the current division rank. Winning a match while having 3 stars promotes you to a higher rank/division. Winning consecutive matches grants an extra star, up to the Gold division.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/6fc105f7669085fb6e0058c3776a29b16b26a8c6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/28e032c69cd2ec25685f4967989c005689bea420.png
You cannot de demoted once you reach a division. Eg. You cannot go back to Silver after reaching Gold.

When reaching the All-Star division, your MMR rank on the global leader board is displayed instead.


Private Lobbies

notes.title: Update v0.3.6: New Cards & Playoff Challenge Event
notes.content:
This update brings 29 new cards: 3 legendary, 3 epic, 16 rare and 7 common, a new PvE event, and small round of balance changes.

Playoff Challenge Event
With the NBA playoffs in full swing, we thought we would join the party with our own challenge event.
Defeat each stage and conquer the playoffs!

Player Changes

Dejonte Murrei
Salary increased from 26 to 28.
Offense increased from 45 to 61.
Added new passive Foul: Get +1 BONUS SHOT
Replaced second and third skills with two new skills:
Shoot 3 and get +25 TURN METER for each adjacent SPEED teammate. Give your team STEAL UP I.
Shoot 3 and get +25 TURN METER for each adjacent WILL teammate. Give your team BLOCK UP I.

Dejonte was arguably the worst legendary card in the pool, and was in need of a rework. We gave him a large offense boost to improve his scoring capabilities, two new skills that enforce his Will-Speed dual synergy, and a new passive to mitigate the draw back of fouling.

Stephon Curri
Replaced third skill with Switch with a random Winh teammate and Shoot 3. Move to the other wing position and Shoot 3.

Stephon did not have a third skill that synergies with his passive kit. This is now fixed, and also provides an extra boost for move decks, that get two new triggers.

Jimmi Buttler
Offense increased from 53 to 58.
Block increased from 6 to 9.
Playmaking increased from 73 to 75.
Stamina increased from 62 to 68.
Replaced second skill with Catch Up Shots - 5 shots.
Removed passive 4th Quarter: Get Clutch Blocker.
Added passive Behind: Get Hustler.

We felt the need to buff Jimmi to match his real world performance. The addition of Hustler makes him a stats monster when behind, and the addition off Catch Up Shots greatly improves his scoring capabilities.

Bizmak Bionbo
Removed passive Defensive Rebound: Get +10 TURN METER.
Added passive 4th Quarter: Get Clutch Blocker.

notes.title: Update v0.3.4: New Cards, Filters Rework & Balance Changes
notes.content:
This update brings 27 new cards: 2 legendary, 6 epic, 12 rare and 7 common, a rework of the collection filters, and a new round of card/mechanics reworks and balance changes.

This update will be live on Thursday, March 30th, in the following interval:


 10 AM - 10:30 AM CET
 1 AM - 1:30 AM PST
 4 AM - 4:30 AM EST
 5 PM - 5:30 PM China Standard Time


One major change we're doing in this update is no longer allowing player activations after the match timer reaches zero. 

As players familiar with the game may know, Bonus Shots/Passes generated after the timer reaches zero are not thrown unless the player who generated them activates. Well, we fixed this for internal testing, and it revealed a deeper problem related to activation post final buzzer. In the current state of the game, with Bonus Shots/Passes generated post buzzer not being thrown, we get 0-4 extra post buzzers activation. With the above mentioned fix in, this quickly got out of hand, and we often had games with 5+ post buzzer activations. 

With all the extra Bonus Shots/Passes there were more opportunities for steals and offensive rebounds, which generate Turn Meter, which generates activations. Each activation generates more opportunities for generating Turn Meter or Bonus Shots/Passes. The cycle repeats too much for our liking, and just feels uncanny. Balance Changes

The Skill archetype passive has been changed from Receive Pass: Get Skilled this turn into Activate 2: Shoot 1. 

Skilled granted +10% Accuracy and +20% 3 Point Chance.

The previous passive was making skill type players outperform massively as pass targets. They were already supposed to be good pass targets due to their native high offense and 3 point chance, so it was a buff to what was already their main strength, while also being completely useless if they did not receive passes.

For the Will archetype, we reinforced their defense focused role. The Stopper trait, with it's four triggers, has been removed from the majority of non Will players. It is now found mostly on Will players:

 Exploit Speed: Get Stopper
 Exploit Skill: Get Stopper
 Exploit Will: Get Stopper
 Exploit Strength: Get Stopper
Stopper now grants +20 Defense, down from +40 defense.

We made this chance to ensure there are viable defensive counters to all archetypes. Until now, the best way to counter was through the Mismatch interaction, but for match ups such as skill-speed there were very few options available. Will players as the go to defense solution against all other archetypes.

notes.title: Update v0.3.0: Quest System
notes.content:
This update contains the quest system. We initially wanted to include this in last week's release, but it was not ready on time.

It will be live on February 2nd, in the following interval:

 10 AM - 10:15 AM CET
 1 AM - 1:15 AM PST
 4 AM - 4:15 AM EST
 5 PM - 5:15 PM China Standard Time

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/976471cb89ebcb0336e3005e8a2b2a3f3966da5e.png

Here is how it works:

 Each day you will get a new daily quest, up to a maximum of 3.
 Each week you will get new weekly quests, up to a maximum of 3.
 You can re-roll a quest of each type every day.
 Each daily quest grants 75 coins. 
 Each weekly quest grants 250 coins.
 Quests can be completed both by playing against the AI in practice mode, and playing against human opponents.


We want quests to be the main way players earn coins, so we have reduced end of match rewards. Playing against the AI now grants 20 coins per win and 10 coins per loss, down from 30/15.
Playing against other players now grants 30 coins per win and 15 coins per loss, down from 50/25.

This may seem like a big hit to coin generation, but in reality the addition of the quest system greatly increased the amount of coins you can generate each week. Assuming someone who played around 30 matches per week, with a 50% win rate, the numbers look like this:


 50 coins per win, 25 per loss. Average coins per match 37.5. 
37.5*30 = 1125 coins
 30 coins per win, 15 per loss. Average coins per match 22.5. 7 completed daily quest, 3 completed weekly quest. 
22.5*30 = 675 coins + 7*75 = 525 + 250*3 = 750. Total is 1950 for playing the same amount of matches while also completing all quests granted within a week.


Thank you and have fun!

Balance Changes

Our main goals with this patch was to reduce the power of the buffing and debuffing archetypes, prevent substitute in abuse, and generally bring some of the over performing cards back in line to where we think they should be. To achieve this, we made the following changes.

All passives that had percentage bases proc chances have been reworked to now trigger deterministically. Here is an example:
Team Buff: 50% chance to get +1 BONUS SHOT has become Team Buff 4: Get +2 BONUS SHOTS
What does this mean? Every 4th debuff placed on the opposing team now grants 2 Bonus Shots. This makes the passive more consistent, while also keeping the same average proc chance as before.

Substitute In & Exhausted passives are now once per match effects. 
A big problem with the buff/debuff archetypes was the ability to constantly sub in mass buff/debuff players. This is no longer possible, and comes with the benefit of also fixing a few other sub in abuse strats.

Team based effects that generated a direct shot or pass now generate a Bonus Shot or Bonus Pass instead. This is a quality of life change that also serves as a nerf to engine type decks like rebounding.

Having shots/passes trigger one at a time extended the duration of the game, without adding any value. Furthermore, engine decks like rebounding were getting triggers that allowed them to keep generating shots/passes continuously during a single activation, which when combined with various players generating turn meter cause two problems:

 Turns were taking a long amount of time. When your opponents did this it felt like you were barely playing the game. Even if the activation count was even, turns for one of the players were taking much longer and gave the feeling that they were playing more than you.
 The shot/pass engine type gameplay combined with Turn Meter generation allow multiple consecutive activations for some players. This was actually making them play more. Activations during a match are a limited resources. Having one player get significantly more than the other will often give them an insurmountable advantage.

The addition of more Bonus Shots/Passes to the game has an extra indirect benefit, as it also buffs skills that remove the two, since they are now more common than before.

Lastly, we generally reduced offense and/or increased defense for most players. Until now we treated offense and defense as symmetrical opposites, but offense is actually much stronger than defense because it generates points, while defense does not remove points. Furthermore, defense doesn't even completely negate a shot since it can still be rebounded offensively. After this change offense is still stronger, but by a significantly lower margin.
